top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the investigation and video, it was found that the caregiver did not demonstrate a high level of judgment or self-control.

top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on information obtained I observed a caregiver pulling a child to the ground and holding in a restraint hold.

top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the course of an investigation, it was determined that a caregiver was yelling at children.

top_violation_types.title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2021 data from February 23, 2022, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2021 by February 22, 2022, as required.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Caregivers were not able to intervene when a child was able to leave the playground and run into the parking lot.

top_violation_types.title: Liability Insurance Requirements -  Provide Proof of Coverage Annually by Anniversary Date of Listing (26 TAC §742.403(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation has not verified liability insurance.

top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.
